name: Tomb Opening
description: The rough cave walls smooth into worked stone. A fitted stone wall blocks the way, a circular hollow set at its center like a missing keystone. One panel looks slightly misaligned; a thin draft touches the air.

interactables.name: circular hollow
interactables.examine_text: A perfectly carved recess. Something round and coral-shaped would fit snugly.

place.success_text: The idol fits the hollow. The wall grinds aside, revealing the tomb beyond. A passage opens to the north.

interactables.name: worked stone seam
interactables.examine_text: A faint seam runs along the wall. The air is cooler here, like it slips through from somewhere else.

success.success_text: You find a concealed door in the worked stone. A hidden passage is revealed to the east.

search.fail_text: You find nothing but cold stone.
